title: 第022章 第一次约会第023章 路遇地头蛇

云梦蝶回到家半小时，已经过去，自己亲自下厨为家人做了一桌丰盛的晚餐。当然，并不是他一个人所为，而是有保姆帮忙。
老爷子老太太这时候也从外面回来，看见桌上已经摆满了各种菜肴，云开阳抬起手腕看了一下时间，“现在这个点就把饭菜做好了，保姆是不是看错了时间？”
话音刚落，就看见云梦蝶捆着围裙，端着一盆汤走了出来。
老太太云云柳氏好奇的问道：“乖孙女，你今天那么清闲，这么早回来了？而且饭菜都已经做好了。”
云梦蝶放好汤，解下围裙说道：“爷爷奶奶，早一点吃饭不好吗？吃完饭还可以去遛个弯什么的。现在就等爸爸妈妈回来了！”这时候，云梦蝶又不好意思说出来是为了秦延军，而提前做的饭，故意在爷爷奶奶面前撒了个谎！
正说着，门外传来钥匙开门的声音。云梦蝶眼睛一亮，以为是秦延军来了，结果走进来的是父母。
云父云母看到满桌饭菜也是一愣，云母笑着说：“哟，蝶蝶今天这么勤快呀。”
云梦蝶有些失落，但还是强颜欢笑地招呼父母坐下。一家人围坐在桌前，边吃边聊。
这时，门铃突然响了起来。云梦蝶眼睛瞬间放光，她急忙起身去开门。打开门，果然是秦延军。
秦延军手里还提着一些礼品，笑着说：“叔叔阿姨，爷爷奶奶，冒昧来访，一点小意思。”
众人看到秦延军都十分惊讶，云梦蝶红着脸解释道：“我邀请阿军来家里吃饭的，他这几天闭关很辛苦，我估计都没有吃饭。”
云开阳爽朗地大笑：“好啊，小伙子，快进来一起吃。”于是，秦延军也加入了这温馨的晚餐，饭桌上的氛围变得更加热闹起来。
吃饭间，云金刚好奇地问秦延军：“小秦，你这闭关是在做什么呀？”
秦延军放下碗筷，恭敬地说：“叔叔，我在修炼一种功法，提升自身实力，就是那天那位突然出现的白胡子老前辈传授给我的。”
云金刚有些惊讶：“修炼功法？这听起来像小说里的情节啊。”
秦延军微微一笑：“叔叔，这世上有很多未知的东西，修炼之事确实存在。”
柳新梅也来了兴趣：“那你修炼了有啥特别的本事不？”
秦延军想了想，伸出手，随后指尖竟燃起一小簇蓝色火焰，众人皆惊。云梦蝶一脸崇拜地看着秦延军。
云开阳更是来了兴致：“小伙子，这火焰挺神奇啊，还有别的不？”

秦延军又凝聚出一个水球，在手中转动。一家人看得目瞪口呆，纷纷感叹神奇。
饭后，秦延军和云梦蝶在客厅陪家人聊天，分享着修炼中的趣事，一家人其乐融融，时间也在欢声笑语中悄然流逝。
聊了好一阵，云梦蝶看见爷爷奶奶和父母都追着秦延军，问这问那，于是说道：“阿军，你来江海应该还没有到处去逛过吧？正好今晚有时间，我带你去到处逛逛，欣赏一下江海的夜景。”
云柳氏满脸笑容的说道：“阿军，年轻人就是应该到外面走走，见一见繁华的世界。今晚，你们俩就去好好的约会，让梦蝶给你做向导，顺便谈个情说个爱。呵呵呵呵！”

Half an hour had passed since Yun Mengdie returned home. She personally cooked a sumptuous dinner for her family. Of course, he didn't do it alone, but the nanny helped.
The old man and the old lady also came back from outside at this time. Seeing that the table was already filled with various dishes, Yun Kaiyang raised his wrist and looked at the time. "The food is ready at this hour. Did the nanny read the wrong time?"
As soon as he finished speaking, he saw Yun Mengdie walking out wearing an apron and carrying a basin of soup.
The old lady Yunyun Liu asked curiously: "My dear granddaughter, you have such a free time today and you came back so early? And the food has been prepared."
Yun Mengdie put the soup, took off her apron and said, "Grandpa and grandma, wouldn't it be better to eat earlier? After dinner, you can go for a walk or something. Now just wait for mom and dad to come back!" At this time, Yun Mengdie was embarrassed to say that she had cooked the meal in advance for Qin Yanjun, so she deliberately lied in front of her grandparents!
Just as he was talking, the sound of a key opening was heard outside the door. Yun Mengdie's eyes lit up and she thought it was Qin Yanjun who came, but it turned out that it was her parents who walked in.
Yun's father and Yunmu were stunned when they saw the table full of food. Yunmu smiled and said, "Oh, Diedie is so diligent today."
Yun Mengdie was a little disappointed, but she still forced her parents to sit down with a smile. The family sat around the table and chatted while eating.
At this time, the doorbell suddenly rang. Yun Mengdie's eyes instantly lit up, and she hurriedly got up and opened the door. Opening the door, it turned out to be Qin Yanjun.
Qin Yanjun still held some gifts in his hand and said with a smile: "Uncles, aunts, grandparents, it's a small thing to take the liberty of visiting."
Everyone was very surprised to see Qin Yanjun. Yun Mengdie blushed and explained: "I invited Ajun to come to my house for dinner. He has been in seclusion for the past few days and I guess he hasn't even eaten."
Yun Kaiyang laughed heartily: "Okay, young man, come in and eat together." So, Qin Yanjun also joined the warm dinner, and the atmosphere at the dinner table became more lively.
During the meal, Yun Jingang asked Qin Yanjun curiously: "Xiao Qin, what are you doing in seclusion?"
Qin Yanjun put down his bowl and chopsticks and said respectfully: "Uncle, I am practicing a technique to improve my strength. It was taught to me by the white-bearded old man who suddenly appeared that day."
Yun Jingang was a little surprised: "Practice exercises? This sounds like the plot in a novel."
Qin Yanjun smiled slightly: "Uncle, there are many unknown things in this world, and cultivation does exist."
Liu Xinmei also became interested: "Then do you have any special abilities after practicing?"
Qin Yanjun thought for a moment, stretched out his hand, and then a small cluster of blue flames ignited on his fingertips, surprising everyone. Yun Mengdie looked at Qin Yanjun with admiration.
Yun Kaiyang became even more interested: "Young man, this flame is quite magical. Is there anything else?"
Qin Yanjun condensed another water ball and turned it in his hand. The whole family was stunned and marveled at the wonder.
After the meal, Qin Yanjun and Yun Mengdie chatted with their families in the living room, sharing interesting stories about their cultivation. The family enjoyed themselves happily, and time passed quietly amidst laughter and laughter.
After chatting for a while, Yun Mengdie saw her grandparents and parents chasing Qin Yanjun, asking questions, so she said: "Ajun, you haven't walked around Jianghai yet, right? I just have time tonight, I will take you around to enjoy the night view of Jianghai."
Yunliu said with a smile on her face: "Ajun, young people should go outside and see the prosperous world. Tonight, you two will go on a good date, let Mengdie be your guide, and talk about love by the way. Hahahaha!"
